title: Independent MD test of glyme-dependent potassium aggregate formation
difficulty_reasons: Twelve coupled bulk systems require model construction, trajectory sampling, per-anion identity tracking, and convergence assessment.
The agent must validate RDF shells and distinguish glyme-length and concentration effects across the complete matrix.

data.description: Molecular identities, charges, compositions, boxes, and AGG measurement definition.

required_deliverables.description: Validated per-system results, provenance, uncertainty, coverage, and conclusion.
